intentEvidence: Unseen Changes Dot shows which notes are new and which existing notes changed since you last viewed them.
problem: Users need a visual way to quickly identify notes that have been created or modified since they were last viewed.

relations.evidence: The initial structure and file-explorer marker approach were based on Dennis Mojado's Unread Dot.

summary: A marker system that displays dots next to new and modified notes in the file explorer and background tabs without altering note content.
